title: Slack notifications for high-intent PLG signals (#sales / #customer-success) with suppression + HubSpot links
creator: Logan Wright
content:
Goal
Add an OPTIONAL Slack notifier for high-intent PLG→Sales signals to improve response time during pilot + rollout. Notifications should be actionable (what happened, why it matters, next best action) and must respect suppression rules to avoid spam/duplicate outreach. Messages must link to the HubSpot company record (and optionally relevant internal dashboards) without including user-level identifiers.

Background
We already emit scored signal events from the scoring service (ENG-2842) and write them to HubSpot as timeline events / tasks (ENG-2843). Sales leadership asked for a lightweight, near-real-time heads-up in #sales for the top tier of intent signals. CS requested similar alerts for expansion candidates in #customer-success, but only when the account is CS-owned and not already in an active opportunity.

Non-goals
- Building a full Slack “triage app” or interactive workflow (buttons, modals, approvals).
- Posting every signal. This is ONLY for a small set of high-intent signals and only when not suppressed.
- Posting any PII (no user emails, no prompt content, no IPs).

Proposed behavior (v1)
1) Input
- Consume the idempotent, scored signal output events emitted by the scoring service.
- Event must include: company_id (internal), company_domain (if available), signal_type, score, windowed metrics summary (7/14/30d), routing outcome (owner + segment/geo), and HubSpot company ID if available.

2) Channel routing
- Default channel for sales-worthy signals: #sales
- Post to #customer-success only for expansion candidates where:
  - account is flagged CS-managed OR segment = enterprise AND there is an assigned CSM
  - and NOT suppressed by active opportunity rules (see suppression section)
- Channel routing should be configuration-driven (no hard-coded channels in code).

3) Which signals qualify for Slack (initial allowlist)
High-intent only (aligned with PM/GT M review):
- sustained_spend_growth (score >= threshold)
- repeated_rate_limit_429 (>= threshold over 7d)
- repeated_model_routing_failures (>= threshold over 7d)
- security_intent (e.g., security questionnaire / SSO-audit-logs docs engagement)
- contact_sales_event (explicit)
Note: pricing-page repeat visits alone should NOT page Slack (too high false positive risk). Keep as HubSpot-only for now.

4) Suppression / anti-spam requirements
Must not post if any of the following are true:
- Dedupe: event idempotency key already seen (use same dedupe key strategy as HubSpot writes; do not double-post if we retry downstream).
- Cool-down: same company + same signal_type posted to Slack within the last N days (default 14d; configurable). Cool-down should be separate from HubSpot cool-down so Sales Ops can tune.
- Suppressed account: explicit opt-out, “do not contact”, sensitive account flag, or internal/test domains.
- Active opportunity: company has an open opp in HubSpot OR currently in an SDR sequence triggered by PLG signals.
- Pilot allowlist enforced when pilot flag is enabled (ENG-2846).

5) Message format (align with DES-231)
Slack message should be scannable and consistent across signals:
- Header: "PLG signal: <signal_type>" + severity indicator text (e.g., "High intent")
- Company: name (if known) + domain
- Why it triggered: 1–3 bullets, include metric summary (e.g., "7d spend: $X (+Y% WoW)", "429s: N events on /chat", "p95 latency: Z ms" if available)
- Suggested next step: one sentence (e.g., "Offer Dedicated capacity sizing call" / "Start security review packet")
- Ownership: proposed AE/SDR + region/segment
- Links:
  - HubSpot company record (required)
  - Optional: internal dashboard link (analytics view) if stable
  - Optional: runbook link for “why did I get this?”

6) Operational requirements
- Rate limits: Slack API retry/backoff; ensure we don’t spam on bursty event arrival.
- Reliability: failures should not block HubSpot writes. Slack notifier should be best-effort with its own retry queue.
- Auditability: log Slack message ts + channel + company_id + signal_type + idempotency key.
- Config: all thresholds/allowlists/channels via config (and feature flags). No redeploy required for simple routing tweaks.

Implementation notes
- Service: implement in incident-bot (preferred) or shared integrations worker, whichever already has Slack credentials + queue infra.
- Storage: lightweight Redis (or existing dedupe store) to store last_posted timestamps keyed by <company_id>:<signal_type> for cool-down, plus an idempotency set keyed by event_id.
- HubSpot link:
  - Prefer hubspot_company_id from scoring payload.
  - If missing, attempt lookup by domain via HubSpot search (best effort, cached); if not found, post without link and include "HubSpot: not found" (but still respect suppression rules that depend on HubSpot opp status—if we can’t check opp status, treat as suppressed for Slack to be safe during pilot).
- Suppression inputs:
  - Use existing suppression table/endpoint (Benji/Ethan to confirm canonical source).
  - For active opp / enrolled sequence checks: call the lightweight HubSpot read endpoint maintained by Biz Systems, or reuse the reader in ENG-2843 if available.

Acceptance criteria
- For an eligible signal event, exactly one Slack message is posted (idempotent under retries).
- Posting respects cool-down and suppression rules.
- Messages contain the minimum required fields and a working HubSpot company link when hubspot_company_id is present.
- Slack notification can be toggled per signal type and globally (kill switch).
- No user-level identifiers or payload content included.

Testing plan
- Unit tests:
  - dedupe behavior on retry
  - cool-down enforcement
  - suppression evaluation (opt-out / sensitive / internal)
  - channel routing logic (#sales vs #customer-success)
- Staging:
  - send synthetic events to a test channel (#plg-signal-notifs-test)
  - validate message formatting vs DES-231
- Pilot:
  - enable for allowlisted accounts only; monitor volume + false positives weekly with Sales Ops

Rollout plan
- Phase 1 (pilot): enable for contact_sales_event + security_intent only, allowlist enforced.
- Phase 2: add spend_growth + repeated_429 signals once dedupe + suppression correctness verified in the first 7 days.
- Phase 3: general availability with volume guardrails (max posts/hour per channel).

Security/Privacy
- Security review required: confirm message fields are within approved outbound telemetry list (per Eng-Sec thread guidance).
- Ensure logs do not store PII; company domain is allowed.

Links
- Design: DES-231 (Slack notification format), DES-232 (HubSpot naming conventions)
- Related eng work: ENG-2842 (scoring/dedupe), ENG-2843 (HubSpot writer), ENG-2846 (feature flags/pilot allowlist)
- PR (implementation): https://github.com/redwood/incident-bot/pull/214

Status updates
- 2025-02-14 (Benji): Drafted message template + config shape; waiting on final field list from Biz Systems for HubSpot link + opp check.
- 2025-02-20 (David Kim / Biz Systems): Confirmed HubSpot company URL format and recommended search-by-domain fallback; opp check should treat unknown as suppressed during pilot.
- 2025-02-24 (Benji): Implemented notifier with Redis dedupe + cool-down; added channel routing and global kill switch.
- 2025-02-27 (Rafael Mendes): Reviewed retry/backoff and failure isolation; requested dead-letter logging for repeated Slack failures.
- 2025-03-06 (Logan): Merged + enabled in pilot to #plg-signal-notifs-test; ready to switch to #sales once PM/SDR sign off on copy.

Follow-ups
- Add per-channel hourly cap metric + alert (coordinate with ENG-2845 dashboards).
- Confirm CS-owned routing rules for enterprise expansions (Jasmine/Rachel + Sales Ops).
